display.title: The Whispering Chanukah Candles
display.summary_short: What are the Chanukah candles whispering to children? Bring the light of Torah and mitzvos into a dark world, and add a little more light every day.
display.summary_long: A pre-Chanukah talk from the Tzivos Hashem radio show, aired the week Chanukah 5750 began. Uncle Yossi describes how children stand by the menorah gazing at the flames, and shares the Rebbe's teaching that we must listen to what the Chanukah lights are telling us. Their message: just as a candle lights up everything around it, every child must bring the light of Torah and mitzvos into a dark world. The Rebbe's example: in a lit room you can see what is good to take and what is dangerous to avoid, but in the dark you could sit beside a pile of diamonds, or something harmful, without knowing it. Torah and mitzvos are that light, and they lead to a world of love and peace. And just as we add a candle every night of Chanukah, we must keep growing in holiness all year (maalin bakodesh), so that each day is better than the one before, until Moshiach comes and the golden menorah is lit again in the third Beis HaMikdash.
display.lesson: Be like a Chanukah candle: bring the light of Torah and mitzvos to others, and add a little more light every day.
